title: Display Button Links - Call To Action | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Display Button Links - Call To Action Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046511 Navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage >> Top Hero Section >> Search Box / Call to Action > Click on Select Call to Action. Select the Display Button Links option: This will activate the following fields: Button Text: Add the text to be displayed. Example: Join Now Button URL: Add the permalink that the button will link to. Example /join Button Class: Choose the type of button.
